entries.title: Public MVP launch
entries.summary: Published the initial static-first public-source archive with event records, school coverage, dataset downloads, methodology notes, and reproducible snapshot artifacts.

entries.title: Structured submission and correction workflows
entries.summary: Added GitHub-ready packet generators for source submissions, corrections, duplicate reports, and metadata fixes so outside contributors can prepare structured review inputs without accounts or paid infrastructure.

entries.title: Research workspace, school dossiers, and briefs
entries.summary: Expanded the archive from record listings into research infrastructure with school dossiers, a citation workspace, a reviewer queue, and a published briefs surface tied to explicit dataset snapshots.

entries.title: Reviewer brief and trust packet
entries.summary: Added a narrow outside-review path with a public reviewer brief, markdown packet, trust packet, and checklist workflow so critique can be documented without implying endorsement.

entries.title: Press and journalist reporting surfaces
entries.summary: Added a press brief, a journalist use guide, and a findings memo so reporters can inspect the archive, cite it carefully, and understand what the current snapshot does and does not support.

entries.title: Institutional response visibility refinement
entries.summary: Promoted substantive public institutional responses into clearer event and school surfaces while filtering generic dataset disclaimer text out of response displays.
